_comment: gosec configuration. Single source of truth for the settings used by both .github/workflows/pr.yml (hard gate) and ci.yml (informational). Keep them in sync by pointing both at this file rather than repeating --exclude flags, which is how ci.yml came to reference a file that did not exist while pr.yml carried its own list. Do not set global.nosec or global.audit here: gosec reads "nosec": "enabled" as ignore the #nosec annotations, which resurfaces findings that carry a written justification in the source.
_exclusions: None. The production packages pass gosec with no rule excluded, and that is the gate worth keeping: an exclusion added to quiet one finding hides every later instance of the same rule. pr.yml previously excluded G104, G301 and G306, which matched nothing -- those rules only fire in test helpers, and gosec is deliberately run without -tests. Anything that needs silencing belongs in the source as a #nosec with a reason, next to the code that earns it.
